hypotheses.justification: The proof uses hB only in the two calls `setIntegral_congr_ae (hB.prod measurableSet_Ioc)` inside `hprodEq`. In both, the integrands are equal at every point, not just almost everywhere on the set. In `hleft` the membership `hqmem` is introduced but never used, and the rewrites are by `hτsymm` (proved for all q), `parabolicHomeomorph_symm_apply` (true by rfl) and `buGaussian_timeShift_point_symm_apply σ z` (true for all σ and z). In `hright`, `F (τprod.symm (τprod q)) = F q` holds for every q. So both steps can use `integral_congr_ae` with `filter_upwards [] with q` (or congrArg plus funext), with no measurability needed. The rest of the proof works for arbitrary sets: `MeasurePreserving.setIntegral_image_emb` needs a measurable embedding but no measurable set, `himage` is purely set-theoretic, and `setIntegral_parabolic_to_product` (CaffarelliKohnNirenberg/Foundation/ParabolicMeasure.lean) takes arbitrary Ω and I with no measurability hypothesis. So the theorem holds and is provable for every B.
